evals.prompt: The main product shows the Lakers total at 231.5 but our model file says 228. Where did 231.5 come from?
evals.expected_output: A layer-by-layer trace to the first wrong layer.
expectations: Pins the number with game id, market, value and time seen
Writes value, source and owner for each layer from capture to main product card
Names the lowest wrong layer with evidence, rather than patching the card
Gives a verdict and routes any fix through tailered-ai:one-league-trial or tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator

evals.prompt: Can we just override the partner source price on the card when it looks stale?
evals.expected_output: Finds the layer where the stale price starts and stops a downstream patch.
expectations: Traces the price down to its capture with timestamps
Marks any layer that cannot name its source as missing
Treats the card override as a patch to stop, not the fix
Names an owner for the layer to fix
